nodes.name: Lemma 4, Lemma 5, Section 12.1, Section 12.2: W H P $i$ in ${{m}_{i}} \ge {m}$ tests W H P…
nodes.statement:
With probability at least $1-\frac{\varepsilon}{2}$ over the test design, each item $i \in {\cal N}$ participates in at least ${m}$ tests.

Conditioning on the event that each item participates in at least ${m}$ tests, with probability at least $1-\frac \varepsilon 2$ over the test design, all items are correctly identified using (16).

nodes.name: Theorem 3, Section 8: Near-optimality
nodes.statement: In the sparse regime $d=n^\theta, 0\leq\theta <1$, the number of tests required in Theorem 1 is no more than a ${\cal O}\left( \frac{{P_{min}({{q}^*})}}{{\mu}({\chi}^*) \left( 1-{\mu}({\chi}^*) \right)} \right)$ factor larger than the lower bound presented in Theorem 2. In particular, the number of tests required in Theorem 1 is never more than a ${\cal O}\left(d^{1+o(1)}\right)$ factor larger than the information-theoretic lower bound in Theorem~2.
